name: Gobernación de Antioquia
body: HSTS marked for preload, a CSP from default-src 'self' with base-uri set, nosniff, and a strict Referrer-Policy. But the home page title is just "Inicio", which tells searchers nothing about the department.
lesson: Put the organization's name in the home title, with what people come for. "Home" alone wastes the slot.
summary: www.antioquia.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: the viewport stops people from zooming.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /index.php, /index.php/gobernacion/mision-vision, /index.php/gobernacion/gobernador-y-primera-dama and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: visid_incap_878756, nlbi_878756, incap_ses_993_878756. Set on /, /index.php, /index.php/gobernacion/mision-vision and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 100 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 19 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /index.php, /index.php/gobernacion/mision-vision, /index.php/gobernacion/gobernador-y-primera-dama and 15 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages read.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
The start page sets a mobile viewport
